text: When a meteorite fell, someone carved on it that the First Emperor would die and his land would be divided.
spoken: When a meteorite fell, someone carved on it that the First Emperor would die, and his land would be divided.

pauzy.regula: przecinek, po samogłosce, krótkie słowo (1 syl.)
pauzy.uwaga: brak pauzy w nagraniu — zostaje bez pauzy
